# BEYOND

> BEYOND is a Lagos, Nigeria-based company of skilled professionals that designs and builds websites, web applications, custom software, UI/UX design and AI-powered automation for businesses, startups, organizations and professionals. Tagline: "Transforming services. Creating value. Making impact."

BEYOND currently operates its Technology & Digital Solutions division. A Creative & Digital division is expanding, and further divisions will be introduced only when they are operational.

Mission: BEYOND exists to transform services into solutions, and solutions into lasting impact.
Vision: To build a world where individuals and businesses create meaningful impact, achieve purposeful fulfillment, and attain sustainable prosperity through innovation, collaboration, and enterprise.
Values: Purpose, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, Growth, Mutual Success.

## Services (available now)

- [Website Development](https://www.example.com/services#website-development): Fast, responsive, SEO-ready company websites and landing pages with a CMS.
- [Web Applications](https://www.example.com/services#web-applications): Secure, scalable web apps, portals and dashboards.
- [Software Development](https://www.example.com/services#software-development): Custom business software, APIs and integrations.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.example.com/services#ui-ux-design): Research-led product and interface design, prototypes and design systems.
- [AI Integration & Automation](https://www.example.com/services#ai-integration-automation): AI assistants for websites and WhatsApp, workflow automation and AI features.
